evidence: Category definition explicitly excludes mining interface extensions: 'A mining PR is ipc only if it changes IPC infrastructure itself... PRs whose subject is what the mining interface exposes or how templates are built (category mining), even though they travel over IPC, are not ipc.'
rationale: While the PR edits `mining.capnp`, it expands the domain-specific mining API rather than IPC infrastructure, serialization mechanics, or process management.
